cases.witness: TYPE: REF(type.counter), where type.counter is DEFINE KIND kind.type BASE INTEGER
cases.expected: Same values and equality as INTEGER; bare type.counter is not a type.

cases.witness: TYPE: NULL; VALUE: NULL
cases.expected: One NULL literal derivation interpreted as a type only in the TYPE slot.

cases.witness: BASE ENUM; ITEM: ready; ITEM: done, used through two transparent aliases
cases.expected: Both aliases preserve the same enum domain; an unrelated ready domain is incompatible.

cases.witness: REF(output.copy).TARGET before OUTPUT value binding
cases.expected: Select the declaration TARGET field; do not read the unbound OUTPUT value.

cases.witness: REF(data.record).name with a bound OBJECT value
cases.expected: Read the bound value once and select lowercase field name.

cases.witness: A REFERENCE-typed binding read by equality
cases.expected: Compare stored reference identity without a second dereference.
10, 20, MISSING, MISSING respectively; no negative wraparound.

cases.witness: COUNT(value: "abc")
cases.expected: error.grammar.invalid: pure calls accept positional arguments only.

cases.witness: TYPE: BOOLEAN; VALUE: true
cases.expected: Treat true as a lowercase identifier, not TRUE; it is not a BOOLEAN value, so error.type.mismatch.

cases.witness: version: "0.1.0" in a required VERSION field position
cases.expected: error.keyword.case.

cases.witness: FALSE AND (1 / 0 == 0)
cases.expected: FALSE; the division is statically well-typed but is not evaluated.

cases.witness: TRUE OR (1 + "x" == 0)
cases.expected: error.operator.operand from static checking of the skipped expression.

cases.witness: ALL([]), ANY([]), NONE([])
cases.expected: TRUE, FALSE, TRUE respectively; immediate empty argument supplies BOOLEAN context.

cases.witness: ALL([TRUE, UNKNOWN]) inside a condition
cases.expected: UNKNOWN; the immediate sequence is transient and cannot be stored as LIST data.

cases.witness: SUM of a declared LIST[INTEGER] value []
cases.expected: error.operator.operand because SUM requires a nonempty typed collection.

cases.witness: SUM([]) without a unique member-type context
cases.expected: error.type.mismatch; empty literal member type cannot be inferred.

cases.witness: COUNT(BYTES(8)), EMPTY(BYTES(0)), COUNT("A😀")
cases.expected: 8, TRUE, 2 respectively; STRING counts Unicode scalar values.

cases.expected: result.value.value equals INTEGER 5; the fragment consumes exactly one EXPRESSION.

cases.witness: core.calculate expression "1; 2"
cases.expected: error.operation.parameter; the fragment must consume exactly one expression.

cases.witness: core.compare target 1 against 2 with criteria omitted
cases.expected: Successful result.value.value FALSE; false comparison is not invocation failure.

cases.witness: core.group of [{tag: "a"}, {tag: "b"}, {tag: "a"}] with key "tag"
cases.expected: Two ordered {key, items} records: a contains first/third occurrences; b contains second.

cases.witness: ACTION RETRY LIMIT 2; initial failure then successful first retry
cases.expected: Two actual attempts, no third attempt, no exhaustion.

cases.witness: ACTION RETRY LIMIT 2 WHEN FALSE after first failure
cases.expected: One attempt; previous failure remains unhandled; no success or count exhaustion.

cases.witness: ACTION RETRY LIMIT 2; all three attempts fail
cases.expected: error.retry.exhausted after exactly three actual unsuccessful attempts.

cases.witness: STEP contains an inline RETRY block
cases.expected: error.block.field; RETRY is inline ACTION-only.

cases.witness: DEFINE kind.error BASE error.required.missing MEANING "Missing required datum"
cases.expected: Alias inherits the canonical error stage, status, event, recovery and phase rules; no new event or state.

cases.witness: Selected event handler invokes core.continue and completes successfully
cases.expected: Recover the originating diagnostic and advance to the declared successor together.

cases.witness: HANDLER A FALLBACK REF(B), HANDLER B FALLBACK REF(A)
cases.expected: error.reference.cycle before invocation.

cases.witness: A ready non-root optional execution unit has WHEN FALSE
cases.expected: status.skipped; the transition must be registered.

cases.expected: TRUE under ASCII folding; non-ASCII case equivalents are not silently added.

cases.expected: error.literal.invalid; lookaround is outside the closed REGEX grammar.

cases.expected: TRUE; standalone ** consumes zero or more complete path segments.

cases.witness: VALUE: [ followed by LF, one deeper indentation level with 1, then 2 on the next comma-separated line, closing ] aligned with VALUE
cases.expected: Valid multiline LIST literal under an expected LIST[INTEGER] type; no arbitrary expression line wrapping.

cases.witness: VALUE triple-quote at indent4; content a at indent8; closing triple-quote at indent4
cases.expected: Decoded STRING is a followed by one LF; opening LF and closing-line indentation contribute nothing.

cases.witness: Same multiline STRING with one extra space before a on the content line
cases.expected: Decoded STRING preserves that one extra leading space and the content-line LF; it is not a structural indentation violation.

cases.witness: VALUE: "\uD83D\uDE00"
cases.expected: One Unicode scalar U+1F600; COUNT is 1.

cases.witness: VALUE: "\uD800"
cases.expected: error.literal.escape; lone surrogates are not STRING values.

cases.witness: VALUE: "\n"
cases.expected: A legal decoded LF scalar, distinct from a forbidden raw line break inside single-line quotes.

cases.witness: REGEX("a") == REGEX("[a]")
cases.expected: FALSE; pattern representation identity, not accepted-language equivalence.

cases.witness: URI("https://EXAMPLE.invalid/") == URI("https://example.invalid/")
cases.expected: FALSE; exact decoded spelling is not URI resource equivalence.

cases.expected: FALSE; address-form identity preserves decoded spelling while containment independently checks resolved targets.

cases.expected: error.object.schema; schemas are not implicitly merged.
error.literal.invalid; Core seconds are 00..59.

cases.expected: Unequal: keys are -3600 and 82800 seconds without day wrapping.

cases.expected: Returned STRING bc. End is exclusive and Unicode scalars are the indexing unit.

cases.witness: core.read range {unit: "line", start: 0, end: 1} on STRING a LF b
cases.expected: Returned STRING a followed by LF; line terminators are retained.

cases.expected: error.value.out_of_range; negative, inverted, or excessive bounds are never clipped.

cases.expected: error.operation.parameter; schema requires a reference to a resolved object-schema type, including aliases.

cases.witness: TASK has ACTION field then PHASE field, each with a reference LIST
cases.expected: Children expand in that field order and left-to-right LIST order; sequential predecessor edges govern execution.

cases.witness: Two distinct STEP activation paths select the same ACTION source declaration
cases.expected: error.execution.order before effects; bounded loop/retry template replication remains allowed.

cases.witness: A sequential second sibling requests BEFORE the first sibling
cases.expected: error.execution.order; explicit ordering may not reverse the required sequential edge.

cases.witness: Two ACTION declarations select the same OUTPUT, including mutually exclusive branches
cases.expected: error.execution.order before effects; one producing ACTION declaration per OUTPUT per candidate invocation.

cases.witness: ACTION.OUTPUT is a LIST of two OUTPUT references
cases.expected: error.field.type; an ACTION selects at most one OUTPUT; TASK/EXECUTE export lists remain legal.

cases.witness: An OUTPUT producer is inside a FOR EACH body but its bound value is read outside that loop
cases.expected: error.reference.unresolved at static resolution; no implicit last-value or collection aggregation.

cases.witness: A failed attempt had permitted partial command output and another retry begins
cases.expected: The new attempt starts unbound. Old partial output remains ordered local evidence; selected final projection retains ordinary bound/partial/unbound policy.

cases.witness: An imported document contains an unrelated targetless VERIFY FALSE
cases.expected: Import alone does not activate the check. Explicit check prerequisites can select it.

cases.witness: A selected REQUIRED TRUE TEST assertion is FALSE
cases.expected: The enclosing required obligation uses error.verification.failed; core.test may independently produce a completed passed FALSE result.

cases.witness: EXECUTE selects an ACTION with no TASK SUCCESS field
cases.expected: Completion requires its applicable required graph/check/rule/evidence/OUTPUT obligations; no unavailable SUCCESS field is invented.

cases.witness: Graph construction yields error.execution.order while the invocation is ready
cases.expected: Transition to status.failed is permitted before effects; failure_phase remains producer-relative pre_effect.

cases.witness: An optional VALIDATE is a prerequisite referenced by TASK SUCCESS.
cases.expected: Evaluate the selected applicable VALIDATE before effects; REQUIRED FALSE does not suppress evaluation or emit a required-check failure.
